verse: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
story: Paul has just told his readers that the saving word is not far off, not up in heaven or down in the deep, but already on their lips and in their hearts.

Here is what that word is. To confess Jesus as Lord is to say aloud that He holds the place that belongs to God, and in the Roman world that was a costly thing to say, since Caesar claimed the title for himself. To believe in the heart that God raised Him is to trust that the cross was not the end. The two belong together: the mouth names Him, the heart rests on what God has done. Paul adds that this is offered to everyone, with no one left outside.
Salvation is not a ladder you climb but a word already near you. Say it, and rest in it.
